reviews.title: It has quite high brightness, very good for gaming.
reviews.comment:
I bought this ultrawide monitor to enhance my workspace, and it honestly exceeded my expectations. The screen is enormous, and the curve truly makes a difference, as it feels much more immersive compared to a regular monitor.
I use it to work with multiple windows open simultaneously, and it's incredibly convenient not having to constantly switch between applications. I also tried it for watching videos, and the experience is quite immersive. The image quality is good, the colors are vibrant, and the size greatly enhances productivity.
The design is also a strong point; it looks modern and clean on the desk. Overall, I consider it a very good option if you're looking for more screen space and a more professional experience. I highly recommend it.
reviews.author: Alexander

reviews.title: Sleek design
reviews.comment: Nice monitors for the money. I used these monitors to replace some old high end lcd monitors for multiple dvr camera systems. The camera preview images are much softer and detailed now. These monitors are 1/3 the weight of my lcd monitors and made setup much easier. Image adjustment is easy with the back mounted controls and they keep  their adjustments when power is removed, not just turned off. Sleek looking minimal frame design allows top, bottom, or side stacking to form an tight fitting array. The cables all exit the bottom and can be seen but this is not an issue for what I'm using them for.
reviews.author: RJKJ

reviews.title: Best budget 4K monitor with good features!
reviews.comment:
I wanted an additional monitor for my work setup and debated for a bit before narrowing down on this model. I wasn’t looking for anything really expensive nor dirt cheap with nil features. This one fit the budget and features I needed perfectly.
I recvd it today and got to set it up immediately. It was a very simple to put it together and connected to my Mac via the included DP cable. Yes, I have a docking station with DP port.
The quality is great, very thin bezel and color/brightness are awesome. The screen size was one of the main factors of choosing this one and it didn’t disappoint me at all in reality.
Durability is not something I am worried about as I’m not expecting to abuse it beyond its capabilities. Functionality wise, it’s exactly serving my purpose and I’m very satisfied with my purchase overall. Just waiting for monitor mount to arrive to make it even more versatile.
Overall best budget 4K monitor out there in this screen size and best suited for work setup in my humble opinion.
reviews.author: Starlord

reviews.title: Great monitor, nice upgrade, affordable 4k
reviews.comment: Great monitor for the price! Overall, I’ve been enjoying it so far. Doesn’t seem to be a true widescreen aspect ratio. Did have a bit of trouble connecting my work laptop to it. Plenty of display, inputs and the picture is fine. I’m sure you could pay more and get better quality but for the price and for the size definitely a good value..
